operation.name: GetPayamLookupByName
operation.query: select intPayamid as PayamID, PayamName, PayamCode, intCountieid as CountyID from tm_Payams where PayamName = @PayamName

operation.name: GetPayamLookupByID
operation.query: select intPayamid as PayamID, PayamName, PayamCode, intCountieid as CountyID from tm_Payams where intPayamid = @PayamID
